label: Donut Chart
description: Canonical donut chart: proportional ring + center total. v4 makes the premium sliver sweep RATIO via a self-framed coarse-quantize (a P-divisible S×S frame lets placeRects GCD-collapse on any canvas), so it composes at any size while keeping the smooth sweep + tight rasters. Building block of the repo-tracker hero.

segments.label: Segments
segments.description: Ring segments in clockwise order from 12 o'clock. Raw weights — normalized internally.

centerValue.label: Center value
centerValue.description: Pre-formatted hole value (e.g. "247"). Omit to derive the segments' sum.

centerLabel.label: Center label
centerLabel.description: Small muted caption under the value (e.g. "Total Commits").

ringThicknessFrac.label: Ring thickness
ringThicknessFrac.description: Annulus thickness as a fraction of the outer radius (0.05–0.9).

segmentLabels.label: Segment labels
segmentLabels.description: Per-segment labels on the slices. "percent" shows each segment's derived share; thin slices are skipped.

backgroundColor.label: Card Color
backgroundColor.description: Card surface color. Pass "none" to render transparent when composed under a card-chrome primitive.

renderMode.label: Render mode
renderMode.description: Render strategy. "premium" (default): smooth clockwise sliver sweep — now RATIO via a self-framed coarse-quantize (composes at any canvas). "light": per-segment overlay-stack revealed by enable-gated pops — composable, cheaper, W3-safe.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: draw the layout contract (center value/caption + segment labels fit their cells) instead of the chart.

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from when the namespace isn't already on ctx (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.preset.label: Preset
theme.preset.description: Producer preset/variant to request (e.g. light | dark | high-contrast for @m0saic/theming/v1; producer-defined).

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is already populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the local palette by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens (self-seeds when nothing is upstream).

anim.mode.label: Mode
anim.mode.description: Quantized clockwise sweep, or staggered per-segment fade.

anim.countUp.label: Count up
anim.countUp.description: Count the hole value up on intro.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length (× duration)
anim.introFrac.description: Fraction of the output duration the intro fills (the rest holds).

anim.introMs.label: Intro (ms, override)
anim.introMs.description: Absolute intro duration (ms). Overrides Intro length when set.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Disable all motion — render the static final ring.

anim.label: Animation
anim.description: Intro animation: clockwise sweep (or per-segment fade), count-up total, easing, duration, reduceMotion.
